{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Navy wool crepe church dress, knee-length, deep midnight blue (#0F1E32), heavy wool blend.
Oxford button-up blouse in ivory cotton, classic collar and cuffs, bright white (#FFFFFF), crisp poplin.
Pearl-pearl ankle boots with a low block heel, sleek silhouette, off-white cream (#F5F5DC), smooth leather.
This outfit honors the solemnity of church service while remaining comfortable for sitting through Mass and walking to lunch. The deep navy fabric conveys respect and modesty required for Sunday liturgy, while the ivory blouse adds a touch of refined brightness against the autumn daylight. Finishing with cream ankle boots ensures she can move easily from the pews to her father's table without compromising her neat appearance."}
